target_reader: Developers, site owners and small teams deciding whether a website/application needs a VPS.
intent: Informational/commercial investigation: decide when VPS web hosting is appropriate and how to size it.
existing_results_do_well: Explain control benefits and common application stacks.
Compare VPS with shared hosting and mention operational responsibility.
existing_results_miss: Concise whole-stack sizing model tied to CPU/RAM/storage/network.
Clear cases where shared/managed hosting remains better.
Internal architecture into StealthRDP's existing OS/performance articles.
unique_value: A workload-first decision guide that covers when not to use a VPS, whole-stack sizing, OS choice, operations and growth beyond a single VM.
commercial_connection: Reader can compare current VPS tiers after identifying the application's real resource and administration needs.
cannibalization: No current StealthRDP article owns this selection intent.
existence_question: Why should vps-for-web-hosting exist when search already has competing results?
